missionAndVision.intro: The Christian Reformed Churches of Australia is committed to advancing the CRCA mission and vision in and through local churches. This mission and vision is lived out in submission to the Lord Jesus Christ and his command to make disciples of all nations.
missionAndVision.mission: We are a church reforming to reach the lost for Christ
missionAndVision.vision: We will multiply Bible-based churches which equip and nurture their members and grow throughout Australia and the world.

coreValues.intro: Biblical values that shape the culture of a contemporary, Reformed, gospel-focused denomination.

items.title: Word Based
items.summary: We are committed to biblical preaching, teaching, training, equipping.

items.title: Gospel Focussed
items.summary: We are on mission in word and deed, both locally and globally: kingdom-oriented, outward looking, evangelistic, disciple-making, community-hearted.

items.title: Local Church Empowering
items.summary: We are light on structures and hierarchy, high on support, partnership, mutual accountability and encouragement.

items.title: Prayerful Urgency
items.summary: We are humbly dependent upon God and filled with prayerful, sacrificial compassion for the lost in all the world.

items.title: Historic Orthodoxy
items.summary: We are complementarian, Scripture-regulated in worship, and unashamedly anchored in unchanging truth rather than cultural trends.

history.heading: History of the CRCA
history.lead: The Christian Reformed Churches of Australia (CRCA) includes over fifty congregations across Australia established since 1951 in just about every state and territory.
history.scriptureQuote: the gospel bearing fruit and growing throughout the whole world
history.reformedEmphasesIntro: The Calvinist or Reformed stream of the Christian Church emphasises:
reformedEmphases: God’s honour, pre-eminence and grace in all things
Reconciliation with God through Christ Jesus alone
The work of the Holy Spirit essential for faith and growth
The Bible as the foundation of our faith’s substance
The church as a community in covenant with God
foundingCommitments: Embraced and upheld Biblical and Reformed theology, as expressed in the ecumenical creeds and the Reformed confessions.
Had a national profile that could enfold new settlers and others interested in every state and capital city.
Was governed by a group of elders chosen periodically by the church and linked with representative state and national bodies.

milestones.title: Formed after post-war migration
milestones.description: The CRCA was formed as a result of the post-World War 2 migration of Dutch people to Australia. The desire to start a new denomination grew out of a commitment to establish churches that were Reformed, national in reach, and governed by elders.

milestones.title: Trowel and Sword
milestones.description: The first edition of Trowel and Sword was published by and for the Reformed Churches of Australia and New Zealand in October 1954, with the final printed edition distributed in December 2010.

milestones.title: Steady growth
milestones.description: Up through the 1990s the CRCA experienced steady growth and saw churches established throughout Australia.

milestones.title: Reforming to reach the lost for Christ
milestones.description: Since 2000 the CRCA has renewed its commitment to be a church that is reforming to reach the lost for Christ. It adopted a fourfold task (Pray, Train, Grow, Align) as the framework to expand the CRCA’s gospel impact throughout Australia. In every state there are renewed efforts to continue the pattern of the first CRC churches in Australia: to plant many new churches and also welcome migrants who are making their home in Australia.

fourFoldTask.intro: As a denomination, we believe that we accomplish our mission and vision through four key tasks:

items.title: Pray
items.text: Pray for such an outpouring of the Holy Spirit that we will be assured of God’s love through his Word, seek to please the Saviour in all things, live holy lives, and be filled with compassion for the lost.

items.title: Grow
items.text: Grow healthy churches which nurture and equip their members and, by God’s grace, expand numerically, plant new churches, and embody the Kingdom of God.

items.title: Train
items.text: Equip all members to be disciples of Christ and multiply the number of well-trained leaders who are actively engaged with God’s mission.

items.title: Align
items.text: Reform continually the life of the denomination to advance our mission and vision.

strategies.intro: Strategies to advance our mission and vision in our work in Australia and around the world will be advanced through the various committees of our denomination. Specifically we:

items.title: Mentoring
items.text: We ensure regular and ongoing mentoring/coaching for all pastors in line with the emphases of our Four Fold task.

items.title: Training
items.text: The CRCA trains people strategically for evangelism, disciple-making, and leadership development using both internal and external resources.

items.title: Ministry Pathways
items.text: We resource churches and pastors to develop multiple ministry and leadership development pathways.

items.title: Church Health Analyses
items.text: We provide churches with diagnostic tools to help churches analyse their health, help them plan for the future and strategically put things in place to grow more healthy.

items.title: Resource Church Planting
items.text: We resource ongoing church planting throughout the country. This includes re-planting churches and church revitalisation efforts.

items.title: Mission
items.text: We invest in cross-cultural mission, both locally and globally, which integrates gospel impact and kingdom transformation.

items.title: Church Strategy Support
items.text: We cultivate and refine models of effective local churches which are proven examples of distinctly reformed and kingdom oriented churches for others to learn from.

items.title: Prayer
items.text: We support churches to increase a church-wide commitment to earnest prayer for gospel workers and gospel growth.

items.title: Strategic Partnerships
items.text: We build and nurture strategic partnerships that serve to support the cause of the gospel in local settings and regions.
